title: Pure DoomZ
summary: Pure DoomZ Equip-Xyz build paired with the Medius the Pure package that fetches Power Patron DoomZ, plus generic staples. DoomZ monsters destroy their own cards to search, summon, and equip from the Deck, while Power Patron DoomZ converts any Effect Monster you control into the matching DoomZ Xyz Monster.

summary.title: Starters
points: DoomZ V Five - Amalthe searches a DoomZ monster when Normal/Special Summoned or destroyed by card effect, and DoomZ VII Seven - Elara Sets a DoomZ Spell/Trap directly from the Deck under the same conditions.

Medius the Pure adds or Special Summons Power Patron DoomZ from the Deck on summon and revives itself from the GY, while Theorealize Past Lull summons Medius the Pure from the hand or Deck without allowing opponent responses while you control a DoomZ card.
DoomZ Raiders destroys another DoomZ card you control to add or Special Summon a DoomZ monster from the Deck, and destroys a monster on the field if destroyed itself.

summary.title: Opening: Amalthe / Medius + Power Patron DoomZ
steps: Summon DoomZ V Five - Amalthe to search DoomZ XII Zero - Drastea, or summon Medius the Pure to bring out Power Patron DoomZ from the Deck.

Use DoomZ XII Zero - Drastea or DoomZ Raiders to destroy Amalthe or Elara, triggering their destruction effects to search or Set another DoomZ card while Drastea summons itself and equips a DoomZ Command Equip Spell from the Deck.

Activate Power Patron DoomZ or an equipped Amalthe or Drastea's effect to Special Summon DoomZ Break - Diactorus (Rank 4) or DoomZ XII End - Drastrius (Rank 8) from the Extra Deck as an Xyz Summon and equip the monster to it.

summary.title: Self-Destruction & Equip Xyz Climbing
summary.text: When equipped with an Equip Card, Level 4 Amalthe can Xyz Summon a Rank 4 WIND Machine Xyz (DoomZ Break - Diactorus) and Level 8 Drastea can Xyz Summon a Rank 8 Xyz (DoomZ XII End - Drastrius) by sending themselves and their equips to the GY, while Power Patron DoomZ turns another Effect Monster into the DoomZ Xyz matching its Level and equips itself to it. Note that Power Patron DoomZ and DoomZ Raiders lock you into Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck. Theorealized Medius Special Summons itself while a Power Patron card is out, searches a Theorealize card, and transforms into DoomZ Break - Diactorus when a monster is banished.

summary.title: Bosses, Equips & Left out
points: DoomZ XII End - Drastrius (Rank 8) equips a monster on Xyz Summon and negates monster effects on the field or in the GY.

DoomZ Break - Diactorus (Rank 4) destroys a DoomZ card you control and a monster on the field, while DoomZ XIII Over - Graflareio (Rank 5, also stacked over any DoomZ Xyz) searches a DoomZ Spell/Trap and destroys a card.
Jupredo the Shademachine Power Patron banishes the top 3 cards of your Deck to Xyz Summon Rank 10 Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction, which re-equips Equip Spells from the GY and gains 3000 ATK.

DoomZ Destruction equips to a DoomZ Xyz to lock the opponent out of adding cards from the Deck to the hand except by drawing, while DoomZ Command "D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G." and "A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A." grant protection and pop your cards for value.
Left out: External Ars Magna, Therion, and Springans engines from the page's combo lines are omitted so the list stays pure DoomZ with Medius.

allow.Medius the Pure: Summoned, it adds or summons Power Patron DoomZ from the Deck.
allow.Theorealized Medius: Newest Medius support: comes in off Power Patron DoomZ and becomes DoomZ Break - Diactorus when a monster is banished.
allow.Theorealize Past Lull: With a DoomZ card out, summons Medius the Pure from the hand or Deck.
allow.Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction: Rank 10 named by Power Patron DoomZ and Jupredo.

main: DoomZ V Five - Amalthe
Summoned or destroyed by an effect: searches another DoomZ monster. Equipped, becomes a Rank 4 WIND Machine Xyz.
DoomZ VII Seven - Elara
Summoned or destroyed by an effect: Sets a DoomZ Spell/Trap from the Deck.
DoomZ XII Zero - Drastea
Destroys a DoomZ card you control to summon itself and equip an Equip Spell from the Deck; equipped, becomes a Rank 8 Xyz.
Power Patron DoomZ
Turns another Effect Monster into the DoomZ Xyz of matching Rank and equips itself to it; destroyed, searches a DoomZ card. Xyz-only Extra Deck while it's out.
Medius the Pure
Summoned: adds or summons Power Patron DoomZ; revives itself from the GY.
Jupredo the Shademachine Power Patron
Counts as DoomZ: banishes the top three cards to bring out Jupiter as an Xyz Summon; Scale 1 destroys itself and a DoomZ to destroy a card.
Theorealized Medius
Newest support. Special Summons itself while a Power Patron card is out and searches a Theorealize card; when a monster is banished, becomes DoomZ Break - Diactorus.
DoomZ Raiders
Destroys another DoomZ card to add or summon a DoomZ monster from the Deck; destroyed, destroys a monster.
DoomZ Change
Destroys a DoomZ card from the hand, Deck or field; destroyed itself, gets a DoomZ card back and summons a DoomZ.
DoomZ Command "D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G."
Equip Spell that makes a DoomZ untargetable and lets it destroy your own cards for value.
DoomZ Command "A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A."
Equip Spell: survives a battle, and destroys its holder to summon another DoomZ.
Theorealize Past Lull
With a DoomZ card out, summons Medius the Pure and the opponent can't respond.
DoomZ Destruction
Equips to a DoomZ Xyz and stops the opponent adding cards from the Deck; destroyed, equips a DoomZ from the Deck.
extra: Rank 4: destroys a DoomZ card, then a monster; destroyed with DoomZ or Medius material, fetches an Equip Spell.
Rank 8: equips a monster on summon, and negates monster effects on the field or in the GY.
Rank 5, also on top of a DoomZ Xyz: searches a DoomZ Spell/Trap and destroys a card.
Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction
Rank 10: re-equips Equip Spells from the GY and gains 3000 ATK with Xyz material.
